requirements.name: The page offers the address book as a plain list, each option showing its address, with none chosen in advance

scenarios.name: The page presents its list with no address chosen

tests.notes: asserts the form and one option are visible, not the full list or the address-summary detail

tests.test: leaves the contact address unchecked on load
renders the address-book contacts and feature copy
tests.notes: this is what surfaced the address-summary detail — asserts every option's name and postal-address text

requirements.name: A chosen contact address is accepted and persists

scenarios.name: Choosing a contact address saves without error and persists on return

tests.notes: proves the save only, not persistence on return

tests.test: selects a valid contact, redirects and persists the selection
tests.notes: this is what surfaced the persistence-on-return half of the requirement

requirements.name: The contact address is optional, and saving without one returns to Overview

scenarios.name: Saving with no address chosen is allowed and exits to Overview

tests.test: saving with no contact address selected is allowed and exits to the hub
tests.notes: not exercised by the fit suite — this path is E2E-only

requirements.name: An invalid submitted option is refused without preserving it

scenarios.name: An invalid selection is rejected and not preserved

tests.test: contact validation: when the submitted option is invalid, links to and focuses the group without preserving an invalid selection
tests.notes: this test is what surfaced the requirement itself — a tampered/invalid value was previously undocumented; not exercised anywhere in E2E

requirements.name: The back link returns to Overview

tests.test: back link returns to the notification hub
tests.notes: this requirement was entirely absent from the spec until this pass
